description: This file defines a utility class 'ReportMailingJobDateUtil' that provides static methods for retrieving date strings formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd'. It includes methods for getting today's, yesterday's, and tomorrow's date, as well as a method to get a date string based on a specific enumeration "ReportMailingJobStretchyReportParamDateOption". The class relies on an external 'DateUtils' class for date operations.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobDateUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for date string conversions based on current date or specified options.

methods.name: getTodayDateAsString
methods.description: Returns current local date formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

methods.name: getYesterdayDateAsString
methods.description: Returns yesterday's local date formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

methods.name: getTomorrowDateAsString
methods.description: Returns tomorrow's local date formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

methods.name: getDateAsString
methods.description: Returns a date string based on the provided 'ReportMailingJobStretchyReportParamDateOption' enum value (TODAY, YESTERDAY, or TOMORROW).
